targets.title: Childhood corporal punishment and future perpetration of physical dating violence
targets.evidence_quote: The current study sought to replicate the Temple et al., 2018 study under similar methodological circumstances.
targets.outcome_quote: The current study did not find evidence to link spanking to adult dating violence. Further, this study was unable to replicate previous findings by Temple and colleagues.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall failure verdict in Conclusions.
